description:
Calculate the total cost (in satoshis) for creating a child inscription. Accounts for the extra parent UTXO input and parent return output in the reveal transaction. Content should be provided as base64-encoded string.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

feeRate.description: Fee rate in sat/vB (optional, defaults to current medium fee)

name: estimate_child_inscription_fee
